title: Cheese and Vegetable Pizza, Gluten‑Free Thin Crust

content.title: About
content.content: Cheese and vegetable pizza on a gluten‑free thin crust is a light, flavorful dish made with specially formulated gluten‑free dough, topped with tomato sauce, melted cheese, and fresh vegetables. It is suitable for those avoiding gluten and anyone who enjoys a fresh‑veggie topping.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gluten‑free dough is often made from rice, corn, or potato flour.
A thin crust creates a crispier bite and lower calorie count compared with traditional thick crusts.
The cheese is usually mozzarella, which melts at a low temperature while keeping a mild flavor.
Vegetables such as bell pepper, tomato, spinach, and mushrooms add not only taste but also vitamins A, C, and K.
Gluten‑free products are increasingly popular, and the variety continues to expand.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Cheese provides high‑quality dairy protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The vegetables supply vitamins A, C, K and potassium, supporting immune function and heart health.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Absence of gluten makes this pizza safe for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Thin crust and vegetables contain dietary fiber that aids regular bowel movements.

items.title: Calorie control
items.content: A thinner base and moderate cheese amount keep the calorie load lower than typical pizzas.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Cheese can trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or dairy protein allergy.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Tomato sauce and cheese can be high in sodium; people monitoring blood pressure should watch portion size.

items.title: Gluten‑free flour additives
items.content: Some gluten‑free mixes contain additives that may cause intolerance in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Reheat the pizza in a 200 °C oven for 5‑7 minutes until the crust is crisp and the cheese is melted. Slice into serving pieces and serve with a green salad or pesto sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cooked pizza in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze in a freezer‑grade bag for up to 2 months. Reheat thoroughly before eating.
